title: Didinga language
description: Eastern Sudanic language of South Sudan
extract: The Didinga language (’Di’dinga) is a Surmic language spoken by the Chukudum and Lowudo peoples of the Didinga Hills of South Sudan. It is classified as a member of the southwest branch Surmic languages. Its nearest relative is Longarim.
